slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

a new dish every week

order something you've never tried every time you eat out this month. small risks you choose on purpose train you for the bigger ones you can't avoid.

the open question

ask a question in a group chat or a meeting that you're not sure is smart. the fear of looking dumb is always louder in your head than it is in the actual room.

saying the idea first

when you have an idea in a group, say it out loud before someone else does. ideas don't count until they're spoken, and nobody gives credit for thoughts.

the unknown subject

give 5 minutes a day to something you know nothing about: an ancient empire, a famous artist, how the stars move. learning in small steps is how you stop fearing what you don't know.

once a month, go somewhere alone you've never been: a museum, a hike, a concert. enjoying your own company in public is a confidence nobody can take away.
